contract_scope: Only placement record structure, supplied module hash, exact JSON/D4 types, ID-reference existence and typed namespace injectivity. No geometric equality or source authenticity.

module_record.injectivity: Per namespace; same local fixture/activity ID in A/B allowed; multiple source owners of same unit-local or global target rejected. Different namespace references may intentionally share strings.

dining_record.id_map: fixture-only map table→dining_table, every other fixture→dining_+source key
dining_record.activity_mapping: NOT_VALIDATED: assemble114 lines114–115 separately derive standing activities and west/east aliases; not represented in dining id_map.

transforms.matrix: Exactly2x2 builtin integer signed permutation; booleans/floats/singular transforms rejected
transforms.translation: Exactly two rational coordinate strings; no numeric type coercion

not_checked: Coordinate geometry equal to transformed source
fixtures: Synthetic detached fixtures only, not real source module or model. Geometry-changing fixture is intentionally a positive reference-only test and never admission.
